name: SHOTGUN PVP
desc:
SHOTGUN PVP is a fast-paced free-for-all focused on movement, timing, and prediction. Perfectly timed rolls can stun attackers, rewarding skillful reads.
Movment, Accuracy, and Timing!

👍Like the game for more updates!👍

❗Game is in early development so expect many changes and rebalances❗

💻 Controls:
Q - Roll (dodge)
C - Slide
